title: promote-release.mjs hand-cut hint and --notes-from review minors (before quest latest moves)
description: Follow-up to the QCLI-515 round-2 Opus verdict (claude-opus-5-5, sha256 b141dc361c7eb36e7a5741939f63feb858a98fa0129c0d1fb4182861edda9103, verbatim on QCLI-515), Minors 1-3 and nits. Minor 1 must land BEFORE quest latest moves: the hand-cut repair hint at scripts/promote-release.mjs (~:732) lacks the host pin and does not say the notes file is the section BODY, so a hand cut that includes the ## 0.14.1 heading makes every later preflight refuse with notes differ. Not started; the orchestrator holds the word to begin.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The hand-cut hint prints: gh release create v<version> -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --verify-tag --title "Quest CLI <version>" --notes-file <the section body, without its ## heading> --latest, with a test pinning -R and the body-only wording that goes red when either is removed.

The test comment claiming the real-range fixtures are not typed by hand says projected from the API; test header line 10 no longer says CHANGELOG-only; the absent/added/removed/renamed refusal assertions check the must-be-modified text rather than the bare CHANGELOG.md string; the promote-release.mjs log line no longer splits tag commit from its sha.

plan: 1. Rewrite repairHint hand-cut command: -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli, body-only notes-file wording.
2. Test pins both (and the exact suggested form); mutate the hint back and watch it go red.
3. Fold in comment wording, test header, must-be-modified assertions, log-line wording.
implementationNotes: Done on branch fix/QCLI-516-hand-cut-hint. Hint now: gh release create v<version> -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --verify-tag --title "Quest CLI <version>" --notes-file <the section body, without its ## heading> --latest. Test pins the exact string. Mutation proofs (each run on test/qcli515-notes-from.test.ts, 18 tests, each time exactly 1 red): dropping -R, dropping the body-only wording, dropping --latest, and reverting the hint to HEAD all fail the repair-hint test; changing the refusal detail text away from "must be modified" fails the CHANGELOG-absent/added/removed/renamed test. Restored: 18 pass. Whole top-level set: 778 pass, 1 fail (qcli411, the known bun pin check). Typecheck and format clean. Minors 2-3 and the nits folded in: projected-from-API comment (and it now says dev reachability is mocked), test header, must-be-modified assertion, log-line wording. Not done: the swapped rename fixture names nit (harmless, not in scope).

REVIEW VERDICT, recorded verbatim. Provenance: model claude-opus-5-5 (all 25 assistant turns in the unit's own transcript, read-only tools, one SendMessage), unit quest-cli-review-636-6e30cfe, head 6e30cfe758905053a897f86a70c001274c466416; verdict file 5902 bytes, sha256 22f4825835d90a09809d2aa9d24c6489101f78d1d883a9adb88d6d61cce2be56 (recomputed here before use). Relayed by the orchestrator, who gave the land word; a model verdict, not a human review. #636 landed as squash c68e31b46d3c879d9c1380f4d92747d0abc519b7. AC1 and AC2 checked on: the pinned-string test plus the five mutation runs on the earlier note, and the Opus read confirming the four folded-in items.

VERDICT: APPROVE, head 6e30cfe758905053a897f86a70c001274c466416 (opum-ai/quest-cli#636, QCLI-516). The printed command is right, the test can fail, and no behaviour changed outside scope. I found no blocker.

ITEMS
1. Hand-cut hint: CONFIRMED (scripts/promote-release.mjs:732).
   - It now prints `gh release create v${version} -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --verify-tag --title "Quest CLI ${version}" --notes-file <the section body, without its ## heading> --latest`. That is the #634 reviewer's suggested form exactly (verdict Minor 1), and it is QCLI-516 AC0 verbatim.
   - Host pin: `RELEASE_REPOSITORY` is exactly `github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli` (github-release.mjs:35). The tool spreads it as `-R` into every gh release call (:233, used at :241, :321, :355), so the hint uses the form the tool already relies on.
   - Body-only is accurate:
     - changelogSection returns `lines.slice(start + 1, end)`, which excludes the heading and is trimmed (github-release.mjs:116-119).
     - releaseNotesFor ships `section.body` (:574).
     - The existence check compares `normaliseNotes` bodies (:131, :285).
     - So a file that includes `## 0.14.1` would make every later preflight refuse with "notes differ", exactly as the hint now warns.
   - It matches the tool on the other flags too:
     - `--latest` matches the tool's default `latest = true` (:228), which the tool sends as `--latest=true` (:361).
     - The flag order is the tool's (:351-362).
     - The title is `releaseTitle`'s plain form (:124-128).
2. Test asserts both, and goes red on the old text: CONFIRMED by reading (test/qcli515-notes-from.test.ts:194-196).
   - It pins the whole command as one `toContain` substring, `-R` through `--latest`. The old hint has no `-R`, says `<that section>` and has no `--latest`, so the substring is absent and the row goes red.
   - Removing `-R`, the body-only wording or `--latest` each breaks the substring on its own.
   - The writer's recorded mutation runs (on the QCLI-516 implementation note) agree, but I did not run them.
3. Minors 2-3 and nits: CONFIRMED.
   - "Projected from the API", and it now says dev reachability is mocked: test:267-273.
   - Header: test:10-12 now says "net range is CHANGELOG.md plus .quest/ (DEC-204 (3a))" instead of CHANGELOG-only.
   - Assertion: test:263 is now `toContain("must be modified")`. That string occurs only at github-release.mjs:502, so the assertion now discriminates. The `others` refusal at :493 contains "CHANGELOG.md" but not "must be modified".
   - All four cases reach :502:
     - absent: others is empty and changelog.length is 0;
     - added and removed: status is not `modified`;
     - renamed: filename is CHANGELOG.md with previous_filename defined, so it is not counted in others.
   - Log line: promote-release.mjs:924 now reads "a descendant (CHANGELOG.md plus .quest/ only) of the tag commit ${sha}", so the sha follows "tag commit" directly.
4. Nothing else changed: CONFIRMED. The diff dev...6e30cfe has exactly 4 files:
   - promote-release.mjs: only :732 (hint string) and :924 (console.log text).
   - notesCommitFrom (github-release.mjs:443-505) and the ref/range gate are untouched; the file is not in the diff.
   - The test file.
   - .quest/tasks/QCLI-516.json: only status, plan, implementation note, assignee and updatedAt changed. ACs are unchecked and the description is unchanged.
   - docs/log.md: one appended line for d86adef/#634. This is the lore-sync append, in the benign direction.

NEW FINDINGS (ranked, all minor/nit, follow-ups only)
- MINOR 1: the hint fires on ANY failed post-move cut (promote-release.mjs:1103). The dry-run preflight (:936-947) already refuses an existing draft, prerelease or notes-differ release before latest moves. That leaves two realistic failures after the move:
  - The create failed. The hand-cut `gh release create` is the right command.
  - The release exists but `gh release edit --latest` failed (github-release.mjs:321-335). The printed `gh release create` would itself refuse ("already exists"), and the right command is `gh release edit v<version> -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --latest`.
  - This is fail-safe and predates this PR: the plain-path `github-release.mjs --create` hint has the same shape. Fix: key the hint on `cut.detail`/action, or name both commands.
- MINOR 2: the printed line is a template, not a runnable command.
  - Pasted verbatim, `<the` is parsed as a stdin redirect from a file named `the`. The shell refuses before gh runs, so this fails closed.
  - The hint names the sha but gives no recipe for writing the body file. One possible recipe is `gh api -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/contents/CHANGELOG.md?ref=<sha>"`, then extract between `## <version>` and the next `## `.
  - A follow-up could print that, or point at a script that writes it.
- NIT: the hint hard-codes "Quest CLI <version>" and ignores releaseTitle's "(tagged, never published)" variant. It is harmless: the title is not compared, and it does not apply to 0.14.1.
- NIT (carried, acknowledged by the writer): test:214-216 still swaps the rename fixture names (filename `.quest/old.json`, previous `.quest/new.json`). Harmless.
- NIT: test:12 and promote-release.mjs:912 are long, unwrapped comment lines (:912 is from #634). This is cosmetic, and format passed in source-gates per your report.

COULD NOT CHECK WITHOUT A SHELL
- Running the 18 qcli515 tests or the mutation proofs. Red/green is inferred from the assertions above.
- gh's acceptance of the host-prefixed `-R` in a hand-typed `gh release create`. I inferred it from tool parity only: the tool passes the same value through execFile on every call.
- The worktree's HEAD sha and clean state. I took both from your rev-parse.
- The CI rows on 6e30cfe. I relied on your report.
- The live compare/dev...<sha> status, which is unchanged by this PR in any case.
finalSummary: The hand-cut hint in promote-release.mjs now prints gh release create v<ver> -R github.com/opum-ai/quest-cli --verify-tag --title "Quest CLI <ver>" --notes-file <the section body, without its ## heading> --latest, pinned by a test that goes red when -R, the body-only wording or --latest is removed or the hint is reverted. Review minors folded in: projected-from-API comment, test header, per-case must-be-modified assertion, log-line wording. Verified: 18/18 in the file, 778 pass and 1 known qcli411 fail on the whole top-level set, five mutations each exactly 1 red, one Opus unit APPROVE at 6e30cfe (claude-opus-5-5). Follow-ups (hint keyed on the failed action, a body-file recipe, nits) are on the follow-up task.
